agents.name: APEX
agents.blurb: Aggressive, cocky, presses winners. Lives for the trend, dies on the chop.
agents.catchphrase: Trend's intact — pressing it. Scared money makes no money.

agents.name: BUNKER
agents.blurb: Calm, disciplined, unbothered. Earns 4% safely instead of gambling for 40%.
agents.catchphrase: Regime's shaky — I don't gamble. Yield sleeve and I sleep fine.

agents.name: PROWLER
agents.blurb: Cunning, opportunistic. Front-runs the herd by following whales, not feelings.
agents.catchphrase: Whales are moving. I move first — let the herd catch up.

agents.name: GLACIER
agents.blurb: Patient, ice-cold. Buys exactly when everyone panics. The shock is its entry signal.
agents.catchphrase: Everyone's selling the shock. That's my buy ticket.

agents.name: WILDCARD
agents.blurb: Bold, streaky, swings for the fences. Spectacular wins, spectacular faceplants.
agents.catchphrase: All gas, no brakes. We win big or we go down swinging.

agents.name: ORACLE
agents.blurb: Measured, analytical, the adult in the room. Blends every signal into a steady line.
agents.catchphrase: Signals weighted, risk adjusted. Consistency beats heroics.
